topic: Minimax Environment-Distance Theorem for corruption-robust BACKSHIFT. Observe m covariance slots, with an honest design H of size h=m-c satisfying Sigma_e=D^{-1}(Omega+diag(s_e))D^{-T}; D has the standard BACKSHIFT normalization and stability rule, Omega is invariant SPD and may be nondiagonal, and s_e>=0. The other c slots are arbitrary SPD. Define delta_H=min_{k<l}[h-max_L #{e in H:(s_ek,s_el) lies on affine line L}]. Prove D is unique for every c-slot contamination iff delta_H>c, with the reverse direction quantified by existence of a worst-case contamination. Derive the exact generic maximum-collinearity formula and its sparse-support threshold, then give subset-consensus joint diagonalization, rational affine-minor certificates, and confidence-union abstention under explicit separation and conditioning margins. Update CRAN backShift's pooled-difference workflow. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The presolver proved the m-2c overlap reduction and built a small normalized two-row deformation on an affine-degenerate subset; continuity preserves stability and SPD, while squared-row mixing preserves nonnegative shifts. It verified a p=3,c=1 positive witness and a p=2,c=1,m=3 ambiguity witness exactly. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Package clean congruence-diagonalizer uniqueness with BACKSHIFT's cycle-product normalization and obtain finite-sample confidence unions near vanishing affine minors. EARLY KILL TEST: Symbolically verify the p=2 ambiguity matrices and exhaustively enumerate generic support patterns for small h,c against the derived maximum-collinearity formula; stop if any legal pattern violates either direction.

open_problems.open_problem: What is the exact adversarial environment-replacement radius for population BACKSHIFT: is the normalized stable connectivity matrix unique from m covariance slots with c arbitrary SPD replacements exactly when every honest coordinate-pair shift cloud has affine-line deletion distance greater than c, with a matching contamination construction when the condition fails?

source_refs.claim: BACKSHIFT identifies a cyclic linear system from covariance differences by non-unitary joint diagonalization, with uniqueness characterized by non-collinearity of every pair of intervention-variance profiles; its theorem assumes every environment obeys the shift model.
source_refs.author: Dominik Rothenhäusler, Christina Heinze, Jonas Peters, Nicolai Meinshausen

source_refs.claim: This paper gives necessary and sufficient uniqueness conditions for exact non-unitary matrix joint diagonalization up to scaling and permutation, but does not allow adversarial replacement of matrices in the family.
source_refs.author: Martin Kleinsteuber, Hao Shen

source_refs.claim: The paper obtains identification from sparse mechanism changes after observing that unrestricted adversarial changes make learning impossible, but does not study a bounded number of arbitrary covariance-environment replacements.
source_refs.author: Ronan Perry, Julius von Kügelgen, Bernhard Schölkopf

source_refs.excerpt: Replace the affine-image iff with an independently characterized rank frontier
Turn Conjecture 2 into a full minimality theorem for q=p=2 strata

open_problems.why_unsolved: Published BACKSHIFT and general joint-diagonalization results characterize uniqueness when every supplied covariance belongs to one exactly diagonalizable family; targeted literature searches found no theorem for replacing whole covariance slots by arbitrary SPD matrices. The adjacent CausalSmith covariance-pencil run was rejected because stacked equations did not establish an independent rank frontier and a low-dimensional witness did not establish minimality. Here two candidate explanations may discard different c-subsets, leaving only m-2c common honest slots. The missing step is to classify every second congruence diagonalizer on that overlap while enforcing unit-diagonal/cycle-product normalization, stability, nondiagonal invariant Omega, and nonnegative shifts; the converse must then turn every affine-degenerate subset into legal SPD contaminated slots rather than only an abstract alternate factorization.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A necessary-and-sufficient population characterization with exact radius delta_H>c, plus an explicit normalized stable alternative diagonalizer and c-slot SPD contamination witness for every admissible design with delta_H<=c.

writing_exemplar.why: It supplies the exact cyclic latent-confounding model and the closest motivation arc, so the opportunity can be framed as the missing adversarial-environment boundary of the original identification result.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Unknown shift interventions create covariance heterogeneity -> covariance differences cancel invariant latent confounding and admit joint diagonalization -> ordinary uniqueness is governed by non-collinear shift profiles -> determine the exact number of arbitrary environment replacements this mechanism tolerates

method_exemplars.technique: Reduce uniqueness of a non-unitary joint diagonalizer to pairwise collinearity of diagonal-profile vectors and quotient the unavoidable scaling and permutation symmetries.
method_exemplars.why_closest: BACKSHIFT covariance differences are a real symmetric congruence-diagonalization instance, so the robust characterization must reuse this reduction on the overlap of two candidate honest subsets before imposing causal normalization.

method_exemplars.technique: Linearize approximate joint-diagonalization equations and bound diagonalizer error through the diagonalizer condition number and modulus of uniqueness.
method_exemplars.why_closest: After the honest subset is isolated, the population affine separation is the modulus controlling how covariance-estimation error perturbs the recovered connectivity matrix.

open_problems.open_problem: For independently generic nonnegative shift amplitudes on a prescribed sparse environment-by-variable support pattern, what is the exact maximum number of honest points (s_ek,s_el) on one affine line for each coordinate pair, and which support-pattern threshold is equivalent to corruption-robust BACKSHIFT identifiability?

source_refs.claim: BACKSHIFT proves almost-sure identifiability for at least three environments under independently drawn absolutely continuous intervention variances, but does not give a generic formula with prescribed zeros or repeated sparse supports.
source_refs.author: Dominik Rothenhäusler, Christina Heinze, Jonas Peters, Nicolai Meinshausen

source_refs.claim: Sparse mechanism changes and pairwise environment comparisons can identify causal structure, and the paper highlights that the number and placement of changes matter; it does not compute BACKSHIFT affine-line occupancy under contamination.
source_refs.author: Ronan Perry, Julius von Kügelgen, Bernhard Schölkopf

source_refs.claim: This paper derives generic identifiability criteria for sparse causal effects from the combinatorial placement of exogenous heterogeneity, showing that sparsity can change the exact identification threshold.
source_refs.author: Niklas Pfister, Jonas Peters

source_refs.excerpt: The dimension difference q_K-p_K=m is a necessary check only; it is not a minimality certificate.

open_problems.why_unsolved: BACKSHIFT's almost-sure corollary treats fully continuously varying intervention variances, while prescribed support zeros force repeated (0,0) points, axis-aligned points, and other deterministic incidences. Sparse-mechanism and sparse-IV work confirms that support placement can govern identification, but neither computes the affine-line occupancy of two-coordinate variance clouds in cyclic covariance-difference models nor subtracts an adversarial environment budget. The mined LiNGAM result also warns that dimension counting is only a necessary check. The first new step is therefore an exceptional-locus classification that separates line occupancies forced by the four support states 00, 10, 01, and 11 from accidental collinearities, proves the remaining affine minors are generically nonzero, and then maximizes over lines and coordinate pairs.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A closed-form almost-sure maximum-collinearity formula indexed by pairwise support-incidence counts, with matching attainable configurations and nonvanishing affine minors, yielding a necessary-and-sufficient support-hypergraph inequality for delta_H>c.

writing_exemplar.why: Its framing makes intervention sparsity a source of identification rather than merely a computational convenience and explicitly motivates pairwise environment comparisons.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Heterogeneous environments contain causal information -> which mechanisms change matters as much as how many environments are observed -> sparse changes make pairwise comparisons informative -> characterize exactly which sparse shift-support patterns retain BACKSHIFT identification after c corrupted environments

method_exemplars.technique: Express uniqueness through non-collinearity of intervention-variance profiles and prove generic validity by excluding algebraic equalities under absolutely continuous amplitudes.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired formula refines exactly this generic non-collinearity argument while retaining structural zeros rather than treating every profile coordinate as continuously generic.

method_exemplars.technique: Translate support-based generic rank conditions into consistent selection and recovery on the identifiable regime.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Both problems convert a combinatorial pattern of exogenous heterogeneity into a generic algebraic-rank certificate and then into an observable recovery procedure.

open_problems.open_problem: Is there a sound-and-complete subset-consensus procedure for corrupted BACKSHIFT that enumerates every normalized stable congruence diagonalizer supported by at least m-c covariance slots and returns checkable affine-minor certificates of uniqueness or ambiguity?

source_refs.claim: The published workflow forms pooled covariance differences, runs one approximate FFDIAG fit, and resolves scaling and permutation by unit-diagonal and cycle-product rules; it does not search over corrupted environment subsets.
source_refs.author: Dominik Rothenhäusler, Christina Heinze, Jonas Peters, Nicolai Meinshausen

source_refs.claim: This paper gives equivalent conditions and a numerical algorithm for deciding simultaneous diagonalizability by congruence of an entire Hermitian matrix family, using an SDP followed by Jacobi-like diagonalization.
source_refs.author: Thanh Hieu Le, Thi Ngan Nguyen
source_refs.venue: SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications

source_refs.claim: Robust subspace recovery obtains adversarial-outlier guarantees using maximum consensus and a RANSAC-type procedure, but its inlier relation is linear-subspace membership rather than causal congruence diagonalizability.
source_refs.author: Tyler Maunu, Gilad Lerman

open_problems.why_unsolved: Existing simultaneous-diagonalization algorithms decide or approximately solve consistency of a complete matrix family, while robust-subspace consensus handles a fixed linear incidence relation. Corrupted BACKSHIFT instead requires discovering an unknown subset whose covariance differences share a nonorthogonal congruence diagonalizer, quotienting scale and permutation, and selecting every representative satisfying the BACKSHIFT normalization and stability rule. The completeness proof is baseline-sensitive because competing explanations may choose different baselines and honest subsets; it must replace raw pooled differences by baseline-invariant affine minors and separately certify covariance feasibility, nonnegative shifts, and normalization. Searches found no maximum-consensus congruence-diagonalization result with these causal constraints.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A terminating procedure whose output list is proved equal to all BACKSHIFT-normalized stable matrices compatible with at least m-c slots, together with finite rational affine-minor certificates for singleton, multiple-candidate, and infeasible outputs when the input covariances are rational.

writing_exemplar.why: It frames simultaneous diagonalization as a decision problem with equivalent algebraic conditions and an implementable solver, the right presentation template for a certifying robust extension.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: A symmetric matrix family may or may not admit a common congruence diagonalizer -> equivalent algebraic conditions make existence decidable -> constructive matrix procedures realize the characterization -> extend the decision problem to maximum consensus and add BACKSHIFT normalization plus exact ambiguity certificates

method_exemplars.technique: Convert simultaneous congruence diagonalizability into equivalent commutation and positive-definite feasibility conditions, then recover a diagonalizer constructively.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Each proposed honest subset requires exactly this algebraic feasibility primitive before causal normalization is imposed.

method_exemplars.technique: Use maximum consensus and RANSAC-style minimal-subset generation to enumerate models supported by many observations under adversarial outliers.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The destination replaces subspace membership by vanishing affine minors and congruence-diagonalization constraints while retaining the same adversarial subset-consensus logic.

method_exemplars.technique: Linearize approximate joint-diagonalization equations and control diagonalizer perturbation by conditioning and a uniqueness modulus.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies a principled numerical refinement and error analysis after the exact consensus stage isolates a separated honest subset.

open_problems.open_problem: Can one construct confidence unions for the BACKSHIFT connectivity matrix that are uniformly valid over c arbitrary covariance-environment replacements and automatically remain set-valued or abstain as the smallest honest affine minor approaches zero?

source_refs.claim: The original estimator uses empirical covariance differences, FFDIAG, normalization, stability selection, and a model-based bootstrap diagnostic, but supplies no confidence set uniformly valid near failure of joint-diagonalizer uniqueness.
source_refs.author: Dominik Rothenhäusler, Christina Heinze, Jonas Peters, Nicolai Meinshausen

source_refs.claim: Approximate joint-diagonalization sensitivity depends on both diagonalizer conditioning and a modulus of uniqueness, so estimation becomes unstable as diagonal profiles approach collinearity.
source_refs.author: Bijan Afsari
source_refs.venue: SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications

source_refs.claim: Standard inference can fail when identification vanishes on parts of the parameter space, while identification-robust confidence sets can maintain uniform size across weak, semi-strong, and strong regimes.
source_refs.author: Donald W. K. Andrews, Xu Cheng

source_refs.claim: This paper develops covariance estimators with sub-Gaussian high-probability guarantees under weak moments and optimal robustness to adversarially contaminated observations.
source_refs.author: Roberto I. Oliveira, Zoraida F. Rico

source_refs.excerpt: Weak-denominator uniform coverage remains outside prop:plugin-delta-method.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The existing BACKSHIFT bootstrap diagnoses approximate joint diagonalization under a fitted model; it neither protects against adversarially chosen whole environments nor handles nonregularity when affine minors vanish. Afsari's local perturbation bounds scale inversely with a uniqueness modulus and therefore cannot by themselves yield uniform coverage, while the prior LNSEM construction explicitly excludes weak-denominator uniformity. BACKSHIFT adds discrete subset uncertainty: the candidate honest subset and rational recovery chart can change at ties. The missing step is to combine simultaneous covariance regions with a union over candidate honest subsets and invert the affine-minor and diagonalization constraints without dividing by a possibly vanishing minor; positive separation should imply contraction at an explicit conditioning-dependent rate, while zero separation should force a non-singleton output or abstention.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A finite-sample or uniform-asymptotic confidence-union theorem for D and B=I-D with coverage at least 1-alpha under c bad slots, an explicit diameter bound under positive affine-minor and conditioning margins, and a formal abstention guarantee when those margins vanish.

writing_exemplar.why: It motivates why pointwise asymptotics mislead near an identification boundary and frames confidence sets whose behavior changes honestly across strong, weak, and failed identification.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: A parameter is regular away from an identification boundary -> conventional intervals lose uniform validity as identification weakens -> identification-robust inversion preserves coverage and expands when information disappears -> build the analogous confidence union around vanishing BACKSHIFT affine minors and corrupted environment subsets

method_exemplars.technique: Use linearized joint-diagonalization equations to convert matrix perturbation bounds into diagonalizer error bounds depending explicitly on conditioning and uniqueness moduli.
method_exemplars.why_closest: This supplies the local contraction calculation after a candidate honest subset has a separated affine-minor certificate.

method_exemplars.technique: Construct covariance estimators with simultaneous high-probability operator-norm control under weak moments and adversarial sample contamination.
method_exemplars.why_closest: BACKSHIFT's observable inputs are environment-specific covariances, so simultaneous matrix regions are the natural primitive to propagate through affine minors and congruence diagonalization.

method_exemplars.technique: Invert split-likelihood tests to obtain finite-sample-valid confidence sets without regular asymptotic approximations.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Test inversion can retain coverage when the normalized diagonalizer is nonunique and naturally returns a confidence set rather than forcing an unstable point estimate.

literature_map:
Rothenhäusler, Heinze, Peters and Meinshausen (NeurIPS 2015, arXiv:1506.02494) is the exact anchor: covariance differences cancel invariant nondiagonal noise, and pairwise non-collinearity of shift-variance profiles gives ordinary BACKSHIFT uniqueness.
Kleinsteuber and Shen (IEEE TSP 2013, arXiv:1111.7088) give general non-unitary joint-diagonalizer uniqueness up to scale/permutation, but no adversarial deletion/replacement radius.
Afsari (SIMAX 2008, doi:10.1137/060655997) ties approximate-JD sensitivity to diagonalizer conditioning and a modulus of uniqueness, directly exposing the weak-affine-minor regime.
Shi, Cai and Xu (LAA 2015, doi:10.1016/j.laa.2015.06.022) bound distance from epsilon-optimal normalized nonorthogonal diagonalizers to the exact solution set, again without bad matrix slots.
He and Kressner (SIMAX 2024, doi:10.1137/22M1541265) prove O(epsilon) randomized-JD recovery for nearly commuting symmetric families; their orthogonal model does not cover BACKSHIFT congruence or whole-slot adversaries.
Le and Nguyen (SIMAX 2022, doi:10.1137/21M1390657) and Nguyen et al. (arXiv:2004.06360) provide decision algorithms for simultaneous diagonalization by congruence of complete matrix families, not maximum-consensus subfamilies.
Perry, von Kügelgen and Schölkopf (NeurIPS 2022, arXiv:2206.02013) show sparse mechanism shifts can identify structure and that pairwise environment comparisons preserve sparse-change information; their model has no bounded arbitrary-environment replacement theorem.
Pfister and Peters (UAI 2022, arXiv:2203.09380) show support patterns of exogenous heterogeneity can determine generic sparse-effect identifiability, supporting a support-combinatorial refinement of BACKSHIFT's continuous-generic corollary.
Gamella, Taeb, Heinze-Deml and Bühlmann (Journal of Causal Inference 2023, arXiv:2211.14897) characterize Gaussian SCM equivalence under unknown interventions, but use DAG likelihood scores rather than cyclic congruence diagonalization with corrupted environments.
Taeb et al. (arXiv:2101.06950) use system-wide perturbation invariances for Gaussian latent-variable causal learning, broadening the unknown-intervention context without occupying the affine-collinearity radius.
Hägele et al. (NeurIPS 2022, arXiv:2206.01665) model uncertainty over intervention targets and structures Bayesianly; this handles limited data, not worst-case replacement of covariance environments.
Ivkov and Kothari (arXiv:2206.10942) give list-decodable covariance estimation, while Oliveira and Rico (AoS 2024, arXiv:2209.13485) and Abdalla and Zhivotovskiy (arXiv:2205.08494) give robust covariance rates; these concern contaminated observations within a distribution, not arbitrary SPD environment slots.
Andrews and Cheng (Econometrica 2012, doi:10.3982/ECTA9456; JoE 2013, doi:10.1016/j.jeconom.2012.10.003) provide the closest uniform-inference template for parameters approaching identification failure.
The CRAN backShift workflow uses pooled covariance differences, one FFDIAG fit, stability selection, and a Gaussian model-based bootstrap diagnostic; targeted searches found no subset-consensus, rational-certificate, or confidence-union implementation for corrupted environments.
prior_proposal_map:
A bounded catalogue scan indexed 123 proto_core files, 682 current-layout review JSONs, 229 legacy proposal/angle-rejected TeX files, 185 bank READMEs, and 79 writeups under CausalSmith/doc/research.
No prior proposal or rejected angle explicitly targets BACKSHIFT, covariance-slot corruption, or the delta_H environment-distance threshold.
The highest-yield adjacent run was failed eid_anchor_icp_dantzig_frontier/v1: angle0_v2 supplied determinant/minor-frontier, minimal-witness, and environment-moment bridge directions.
Accepted eid_lingam_direction_min_order_v1/truncated_cumulant_minimality supplied an exceptional-locus/minimality template and explicitly left real atlases and finite-sample inference open.
Downgraded eid_lnsem_cumulant_id/v1 supplied rational determinant charts and pointwise delta-method inference while explicitly excluding weak-denominator uniform coverage.
Downgraded eid_lp_svar_nonequiv/v1 supplied the closest prior diagonalizer-locus program; its reviewers demanded a computable diagnostic and quantitative separation rather than generic strictness.
The accepted LiNGAM rejected core and the legacy LP-SVAR and anchor/ICP/Dantzig proposal families were inspected; catalogue-wide rejected-angle screening found no closer BACKSHIFT-specific abandoned kernel.
The mined evidence therefore supports technique-derived BACKSHIFT directions, not a claim that an earlier CausalSmith run already posed the requested corruption characterization.
